title: The French Revolution
text: The French Revolution was a period of radical political and societal transformation in France from 1789 to 1799. Triggered by economic hardship, social inequality, and the Enlightenment's emphasis on liberty and rights, it led to the overthrow of the monarchy and the execution of King Louis XVI and Queen Marie Antoinette by guillotine. The Revolution produced foundational documents including the Declaration of the Rights of Man and of the Citizen. It went through several phases, including the Reign of Terror under Maximilien Robespierre, during which thousands were executed. The Revolution ultimately paved the way for Napoleon Bonaparte's rise to power and fundamentally altered European political life.
